0434a411803905bad418971f437d75694530be03.summary: SentinelOne research on FIN7, a financially motivated group active since 2012 with origins in Russia. It links several underground forum sellers of AV-killer tools to FIN7 and describes AvNeutralizer, which uses a newly seen driver-based method to tamper with security products. It also covers automated SQL injection and Exchange exploitation via the Checkmarks platform, plus Powertrash loaders, Diceloader, Core Impact implants and an SSH-based backdoor. Several attributions are hedged at high or medium confidence.

Examples include phishing by SideWinder, APT28 and BianLian, Volt Typhoon's living-off-the-land activity, BYOVD defence evasion by Earth Longzhi and AuKill, and the COSMICENERGY OT malware described as causing electric power disruption.
